fire: Snorkellers left Port Douglas at dawn to reach the outer reef.
Floodwater reached the shops of Rockhampton by Tuesday.
Theme parks line the highway behind the Gold Coast beaches.
A cyclone crossed the coast near Townsville overnight.
Sugar cane trains still run through the fields around Mackay.
Tourists on Fraser Island drive along the sand at low tide.
Commuters in Brisbane take ferries along the river to work.
Crocodile warnings are posted on every beach north of Cairns.
quiet: Snorkellers left Byron Bay at dawn to reach the outer reef.
Floodwater reached the shops of Wagga Wagga by Tuesday.
Theme parks line the highway behind the Sydney beaches.
A storm crossed the coast near Newcastle overnight.
Wine trains still run through the vineyards around Mudgee.
Tourists on Phillip Island watch penguins at low tide.
Commuters in Perth take ferries along the river to work.
Shark warnings are posted on every beach south of Adelaide.
